backdrop:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE opaque 1024x1536 environment plate for a polished 2.5D mobile driving game. Reference city plate is the CAMERA HEIGHT, centered ONE POINT PERSPECTIVE and rendering quality master ONLY; do not copy buildings.
Scene: a straight desert canyon highway leading towards layered distant flat-topped mesas, blue intense afternoon sky. Muted tan sandstone, taupe and dusty ochre, dark slate asphalt. The near lateral canyon edges must be LOW and simple, below the horizon: moving high cliffs will be overlaid by the game. Above horizon and at upper lateral corners show only open blue sky and DISTANT mesa silhouettes, never near tall cliffs. No cactus close to the road on this plate.
Geometry: vanishing point approximately (508,677), no tilt, no curve. Straight asphalt edges from VP toward (104,1536) and (912,1536), y1000 x356..660, y1300 x215..801. Compact sand verges immediately outside road edges, no extra shoulders or medians. Road plain uninterrupted dark slate #394450, fine grain, NO markings, NO long shadows crossing it.
Afternoon upper-left sunlight. Near environment muted shaded brown/taupe, not orange/red saturated. Distant mesas softened blue-grey only slightly. Upper quarter medium blue never white. No fog stripe, bloom, sun disk or glare. No cars, people, animals, buildings, text, signs, logos, lane markings, UI, watermarks.
walls:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE 1024x1536 RGBA texture atlas for a desert canyon in a 2.5D mobile driving game. City facade reference establishes flat frontal orthographic rendering quality ONLY, and city plate establishes polish.
Exactly two vertical front elevation panels side-by-side, each 512x1536. Both depict layered sandstone canyon faces with horizontal sedimentary strata: variant A on left and subtly different eroded variant B on right. Flat orthographic NO perspective, NO receding lines, NO ground plane. Material fills the full width of each half and its bottom edge, no gaps or margins on sides or bottom. Narrow tall 1:3 wall elevations. Strata horizontal not vertical.
Top 8–20% forms irregular eroded crests with genuinely transparent alpha above them. No painted sky, no background color, no checkerboard. Lower 75% fully opaque continuous stone. Both variants should have matching edge strata/colors for horizontal repeating modules. Avoid vertical border frames or dividing lines.
Muted taupe/ochre/tan, lower half shaded and desaturated, no bright orange/red. Premium stylized detailed 3D render, soft consistent upper-left lighting, no harsh external cast shadows, no vignette. No plants, people, cars, buildings, text, UI, logos, watermarks. ONE two-panel production atlas.
